Important notes:
This ebook includes links to short videos for each recipe - simply click on the symbol
to go to the video.
The macros shown in all recipes are per serving/unit.
Each recipe indicates the number of servings the ingredients yield, as well as the
average preparation time.
Ingredients marked as optional are not included in the macros - they are only
suggested to add flavor or as an alternative to a specific ingredient.
In this ebook, you'll find information on calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat per
serving to help you make balanced choices without complications.
"Macros" is short for macronutrients - the three main components of food that provide
energy to the body:
Protein (P): essential for muscles, recovery, and satiety.
Fat (F): important for hormone production, satiety, and vitamin absorption.
Carbohydrates (C): the main source of energy.
Each macronutrient has a specific caloric value (KCALS):
1 g of protein = 4 kcal
1 g of carbohydrates = 4 kcal
1 g of fat = 9 kcal
The calories in each recipe result from the sum of these macronutrients.
